source:
恋は、今でも
あなたをさがしてる

恋は、いつしか
あなたをみうしなう

恋は、また
誰かに恋する

恋は、また
あなたを思い出す
text:
Love, even now,
is searching for you.

Love, before I know it,
loses sight of you.

Love, once again,
falls in love with someone.

Love, once again,
remembers you.

source:
冬の季節に 夜空見る
星たちを見て うるうると
流れ星には 願い込め
幸せになれ そう願う
text:
In winter, I gaze at the night sky.
Looking at the stars, my eyes fill with tears.
I place a wish upon a shooting star:
May you find happiness. That is my wish.

source:
雨足鳥 今日も降る
秋の目覚め

雨足鳥 斜線の降るる
まるで鳥のよう

雨足鳥 傘さえも
弾き返す

今日、誰思う
今日、君思う
text:
Rain-birds fall again today,
as autumn wakes.

Rain-birds fall in slanting lines,
just like birds.

Rain-birds, even an umbrella
sends them bouncing back.

Who am I thinking of today?
Today, I am thinking of you.

source:
呼ぶ声は近いようで…。
遠く感じてしまうの…。

囁く声は、遠いようで…。
近く感じてしまうの…。

なぜかしら…。
どうしてかしら…。
私には、わかんない…。
text:
The voice that calls seems so near...
yet somehow feels so far away...

The whisper seems so far away...
yet somehow feels so near...

I wonder why...
Why could it be...
I do not understand...

source:
夏の前に降る雨
紫陽花の花が

とおりすがりの人に
ご挨拶

私にもご挨拶して
ゆれていたよ

歓迎してくれたのかしら
text:
Rain falling before summer.
The hydrangea flowers

greet
the people passing by.

They greeted me too,
swaying gently.

I wonder if they were welcoming me.

source:
想いが残る 想いが募るの
あの日は、刻む日に
心に響く優しい気持ち

想いが縋る 想いが詰まるの
今日の日に、刻む日々は
心に残る優しい心持ち
text:
Feelings linger. Feelings grow.
That day becomes a day engraved within me,
a gentle feeling echoing in my heart.

Feelings cling. Feelings fill me.
The days I engrave upon this day
leave a gentle tenderness in my heart.

source:
時間を超えて
愛を超えて

大切な人を守れますか？
奏でるメロディーは、
優しさのメロディーですか？

手綱を忘れずに、
守れますか？
text:
Beyond time,
beyond love,

can you protect the person you cherish?
Is the melody you play
a melody of kindness?

Without forgetting to hold the reins,
can you protect them?

source:
スキが集まると
大スキになる

大スキが集まると
幸せの恋が溢れ出す

ステキな恋
つかめてますか？

ステキな恋
してますか？
text:
When little feelings of love gather,
they become a great love.

When great feelings of love gather,
a happy romance overflows.

Have you found
a wonderful love?

Are you living
a wonderful love?

source:
あなたと手をつなぎながら
海を歩くと
波の満ち引きが
私たちをお出迎えするの

波さん…ありがとう
あなたも…うなずいていた

波さん…大好き
あなたも…うなずいていた
text:
Holding your hand,
as we walk along the sea,
the ebb and flow of the waves
welcome us.

Dear waves... thank you.
You were nodding too.

Dear waves... I love you.
You were nodding too.
